name: Caos Primordial
label: Dano / Aparo
description: Cosmic hit-recoil and destabilized stagger reaction in side-scroller view. Struck from the right: the black eclipse core shudders and jolts leftward, the pale gold orbital ring tilts sharply out of plane, black ink tendrils recoil wildly and orbiting stone shards scatter outward briefly before pulling back and stabilizing into the original hovering equilibrium. Preserve crisp dark hermetic pixel art, same scale and monochrome bone-gold palette. Static camera, transparent background.
